title: Arrest Of Members Of Shanghai Shoe Stall Keepers Lien Nyi Association

page_data.en:

1714
25 / 11 / 42

Misc. 206/42
SOUTH AREA
ROSTOO ROAD
25th November, 42.

1

（印：第二科長 檢）

Arrest of members of Shanghai Shoe Stall Keepers Lien
Nyi Association (上海鞋業攤販同業聯誼會)

At 2.15 p.m. 24/11/42 one named

1. Tsang Shing Ming (張錫民), 34, Zangzoh,
l/shroff, 63 Zung Woo Li (順和里), North Kiangse Rd.
came to station and reported that he was a shroff of
Shanghai Shoe Stall Keepers Lien Nyi Association, whilst
enlisting the name of a shoe stall keeper on Robison Road
near Perry Road, he was assaulted by the shoe stall keeper
who refused to join the association, and absconded.

In the possession of Tsang Shing Ming, there were
2 note books with numerous names of shoe stall keepers,
and several sheets of notification No. 3 issued by the
above association which states that the association has
been registered with and approved by Social Affairs
Bureau, Shanghai Koumingtang Headquarters, Social
Movement Bureau, S.M.C. and other Special Service Corps,
that the association could collect membership fees from
shoe stall keepers varying from $1.50 per month to $3.00
per month. The notification was signed by Chief
Committee Tsang Tsang Loong (張正龍), Committee Mau
Kao Hoong (毛高洪) and supervisor Uo Zen Fung (華傳本),
and office is located at House 7, Lane 344, North Honan
Road.

The Special Section, C. & S.S. Headquarters, was

杂项 206/42
南区
罗斯托路（Rostoo Road）
1942年11月25日。

1

（印：第二科长 检）

逮捕上海鞋业摊贩同业联谊会成员

1942年11月24日下午2时15分，一名叫

1. 张锡民（Tsang Shing Ming），34岁，浙江人，
司事，住江西北路顺和里63号。
来到警局报案称，他是上海鞋业摊贩同业联谊会的司事，在罗宾逊路（Robison Road）近佩里路（Perry Road）一带登记一名鞋摊摊主姓名时，遭到拒绝加入该会的鞋摊摊主殴打，肇事者随后逃逸。

在张锡民身上搜出两本记有大量鞋摊摊主姓名的笔记本，以及数份由上述协会发出的第3号通告。通告称，该协会已向国民党上海市党部社会局、工部局社会运动处及其他特务机构注册并获批准；该协会可向鞋摊摊主收取每月1.50元至3.00元不等的会费。通告由主任委员张正龙（Tsang Tsang Loong）、委员毛高洪（Mau Kao Hoong）及监事华传本（Uo Zen Fung）签署，办事处位于河南北路344弄7号。
